title: Tomato 'Vesuvio' – 2x Mini Plug Plants – Yellow Pear-Shaped Italian Heirloom
description:
Tomato 'Vesuvio' – 2x Mini Plug Plants
 

 A historic heritage variety from the slopes of Mount Vesuvius, producing distinctive yellow, pear-shaped fruits with a characteristic pointed tip.


 Known for their tangy flavour, these tomatoes are perfect for snacking, salads, and traditional Italian dishes.


 Traditionally, the fruits were strung into hanging clusters—a time-honoured method allowing them to ripen and store slowly over winter.


  What you'll receive:
 

 2 mini plug plants, carefully packaged and ready to pot on or plant out once established. Ideal for growing in containers, grow bags, or greenhouse borders.
